summary: First full round of testing for BROGRESSIVE. Wrote comprehensive pytest backend suite (45 tests) covering auth, RBAC, admin (users/assignments/appearance/packages/enrollment), onboarding, plans (nutrition 409 confirm + training publish), all logs (weight/meal/daily/workout), check-in wizard flow, messages, enhanced self-report, payments upload+verify. All 45 backend tests PASS. Frontend smoke: landing, admin login/dashboard/users/appearance/packages, coach login/dashboard/Client360, client login/Today/Program/Log/Progress/Chat all render correctly with data from backend. Data-testids present on login page and landing.

issues: OK - 5 items (Hari Ini, Program, Catat, Progres, Coach) render as spec
Two 401s appear at /login before user authenticates - expected behavior from /api/auth/me probe but noisy; consider suppressing initial 401 in AuthContext or gating the call until token cookie exists

action_items: Optional: Silence /api/auth/me 401 on public /login and /landing pages by gating the initial call in AuthContext or handling 401 silently to avoid noisy console errors.

Optional: Add explicit data-testid attributes to admin/coach/client interactive elements (Buat Akun dialog inputs, Tugaskan Klien dialog, Nutrition Builder calculator, Training Builder set rows, Checkin wizard steps, bottom nav items) to enable more granular UI regression testing.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a monolith at 1458 lines - recommend splitting into routers (auth.py, admin.py, plans.py, logs.py, checkins.py, messages.py) for maintainability.

CORSMiddleware.allow_origins reads FRONTEND_URL but backend/.env has CORS_ORIGINS="*" which is unused - potential confusion (works with credentials because explicit origin is set). Fine as-is but remove CORS_ORIGINS.
In publish_plan the request.json() call for non-JSON content-type is skipped (correct) - OK.
messages/{other_id} check for coach uses require_client_access which is correct; for admin case allows any partner.
Onboarding: parq_flags treated as boolean via bool(data.get('parq_flags')) - if front-end sends a list of flags this becomes True; naming a bit ambiguous but consistent.
Frontend/App.js: hash-based session_id handled at every route change - AuthCallback renders in place of Routes when hash present, works.
Backend does NOT set access_token cookie on google-session (only session_token). That is intentional but /api/auth/me handles both paths correctly via cookie or Bearer.

success_rate.frontend: 100% smoke (landing, admin dashboard/users/appearance/packages, coach dashboard/Client360, client Today/Program/Log/Progress/Chat)

test_credentials: Admin: tiofansha@gmail.com / Brogressive#2026. Test coach/client accounts are created per-run by backend_test.py with random 6-char suffix (e.g. test_coach_019897@test.com / Coach12345, test_client_019897@test.com / Client12345). These UI-visible test accounts persist across runs.
seed_data_creation: Per test run backend_test.py creates 1 coach, 2 clients (1 assigned+enrolled+onboarded, 1 unassigned for RBAC test), 1 package (TEST_Paket_*), 1 nutrition plan (active v1, macro-mismatch 409-then-confirm), 1 training plan (active v1), weight/meal/daily/workout logs, 1 check-in (responded), 2 messages, 1 enhanced entry, 1 payment proof (verified). Admin seeded with real credentials. 26 foods + 22 exercises + 1 default package auto-seeded by server on startup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend_test.py uses `-n 0` (serial) via pytest.ini xdist because tests share session state via a fixture dict. Run with: pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -n 0 -v. All 45 tests pass in ~7s. Frontend smoke was limited to page-load + a few interactions; for deeper Playwright regressions the app would benefit from more data-testids on admin dialogs (Buat Akun, Tugaskan Klien), NutritionBuilder calculator/publish, TrainingBuilder set rows, Checkin wizard, and bottom-nav items.
